To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) We propose a new model, HDPsent, for incorporating sentiment into an HDP framework; 2) HDPsent is able to automatically learn different word distributions for different sentiment polarities for each single topic, which is not feasible in existing models; 3) HDPsent performs comparably to existing models on sentiment analysis, and better on topic modeling.
HDPsent is able to learn latent topics and aspects of sentiment in a hierarchical model.
HDPsent can be successfully applied to a hierarchical topic model and can be used to identify sentiment aspects.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a new model for sentiment analysis that can automatically learn latent sentiment aspects within an HDP topic model framework.
the following question: How can we learn latent aspects of sentiment and topics in an unsupervised fashion?
the problem of sentiment analysis in a hierarchical topic model, which has been largely unexplored.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the model is capable of capturing both topic and sentiment in a hierarchical fashion, and that it is able to capture sentiment in a more detailed manner, as well as to identify sentiment aspects.
HDPsent provides a more accurate and robust model for topic modeling with sentiment aspects than other models.
our proposed model is able to generate different word distributions for positive and negative sentiment polarity for each single topic that has been learnt.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose a new model that can be used for sentiment analysis in a topic modeling setting.
HDPsent can be used to automatically generate different sentiment distributions for each topic that has learned.
HDPsent can be used to automatically discover topics and sentiments within a single model, while preserving the nonparametric Bayesian properties of the HDP model.
The main takeaway from our work is that
HDP-based topic modeling and sentiment learning are not mutually exclusive.
HDPsent is a flexible model that can be used for a variety of applications.
the sentiment and topic learning can be performed jointly, and that the sentiment learning can be done in a nonparametric manner, while still preserving the benefits of topic modeling.
